Question ID: STAT_U05_L01_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.DCR.1

A survey of 80 students finds that 62% prefer online notes. What is 62%?

feedback.text: The percent was calculated from the sample of 80 students.
A parameter describes the entire population, not just the surveyed sample.
The full population is the whole group of interest, not a calculated percent.
A sampling method describes how data are collected.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: STAT_U05_L01_GP_Q02

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.DCR.1

A district reports that the average class size for all district classes is 24 students. What is 24?

feedback.text: The number describes all district classes, so it is a parameter.
A statistic would come from only a sample of classes.
A convenience sample is a selection method, not a population value.
A random sample is a way to choose data, not the value itself.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: STAT_U05_L01_GP_Q03

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.DCR.2

Why does random sampling help produce representative data?

answer.text: It only chooses people who volunteer

feedback.text: Volunteer samples can be biased because only willing people respond.

answer.text: It gives members of the population a fair chance to be selected

feedback.text: Random selection reduces selection bias and helps the sample reflect the population.

answer.text: It guarantees every sample has exactly the same results

feedback.text: Random samples still vary; they do not produce identical results.

answer.text: It removes the need to define the population

feedback.text: The population must still be defined before sampling.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: STAT_U05_L01_GP_Q04

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.DCR.2

Which sample is most likely to be biased?

answer.text: Drawing student IDs from a complete list

feedback.text: A complete list and random draw can support fair sampling.

answer.text: Asking only friends in your lunch group

feedback.text: Friends in one lunch group are easy to reach but may not represent the population.

answer.text: Using a random number generator with a full roster

feedback.text: A random generator with a full roster supports fair selection.

answer.text: Randomly selecting names from all grade levels

feedback.text: Random selection across grade levels supports representativeness.
